title: Welcome & How It Works
summary: A short tour of the training template. Every topic in this demo is named after a **feature** you can use in your own trainings.
objectives: Understand how quizzes unlock the next topic
Know where the content comes from (JSON files)

blocks.md:
Every **subtopic is one page**: scroll to read it, then press **Next** at the bottom. The row of numbered pills above the text shows the parts of the topic — the last one (✎) is the quiz.

The **contents** panel lists all topics. Click the small arrow next to a topic to **expand** it and jump to any subtopic. Use the ☰ button in the header to **show or hide** the contents panel. On a phone it slides in over the page.

rows: Move to the next or previous page (subtopic, quiz, topic)

Switch layout (sidebar / top bar), theme, reset progress

blocks.caption: Main controls

blocks.md:
Every topic ends with a **quiz** page. You need the **pass threshold** (75 % in this demo) to unlock the next topic.

- If you do not pass, the quiz tells you **which subtopics to read again** — click a link to open that page. A yellow box on those pages leads you **back to the quiz**.
- Then press **Try again**: the answers are shuffled and you can retry as often as you like.
- Some questions have **more than one correct answer** — they say *Select all correct answers*.

blocks.title: Progress is saved
blocks.md: Your progress is saved — in this browser, or by your learning platform when the training is opened from it. Next time you open the training it continues where you stopped.
Nothing is hard-coded in the page. The training is described by plain JSON files:

blocks.code:
training.json        title, settings, list of topics
topics/01-....json   one file per topic: subsections + quiz
certificate.json     certificate texts and style
css/themes/*.css     colours and fonts
assets/              pictures and SVG animations

blocks.title: Made for AI
blocks.md: Because everything is JSON, you can ask an AI assistant to *write a topic about X with a scroll-and-learn diagram and a 5-question quiz* and drop the file into `topics/`.
